svg.text: A. Biased select! & O(1) Control Plane (handlers.rs)
Why submission_loop NEVER awaits LLM streams, hooks, or tool execution
tokio::select! { biased; ... } Priority Order (L471–501)
1. runtime.shutdown.cancelled() -> Immediate tree-wide shutdown
2. rx_sub.recv() -> O(1) dispatch of Op::TurnInput / Approval / Interrupt
3. mailbox.changed() -> Wake idle thread on agent mail / durable sleep
All heavy work spawns onto background ActiveTurn::task (AbortOnDropHandle).
The Approval Self-Deadlock Prevented by Spawning ActiveTurn
• ActiveTurn runs bash tool -> awaits approval oneshot_rx in TurnState.
• User clicks Approve -> client pushes Op::ExecApproval into rx_sub.
• Because submission_loop returned immediately after spawn_task(), it is
free at rx_sub.recv() to route the approval and unblock ActiveTurn!
Abort Ordering: Cancel Task BEFORE Clearing Approvals (tasks/mod.rs)
1. handle_task_abort() cancels token + waits 100ms graceful window.
2. ONLY THEN calls input_queue.clear_pending(&active_turn) (L596).
Why? Dropping approval channels first would wake the tool with a fake
"User rejected" tool output right before TurnAborted fires!
B. Atomic 4-Mode Turn Admission (turn_input.rs)
Replies immediately after routing decision—before hooks, rollout I/O, or LLM
1. TurnInputMode::StartOrSteer (L352–475)
• Validates settings via preview_settings() (rejected input leaves 0 mutations).
• Attempts steer_input() first -> if active, applies settings to NEXT turn only.
• On NoActiveTurn -> checks ServerDraining (bypassed for delegated subagents!).
2. TurnInputMode::StartIfIdle + Arc::ptr_eq Guard (L481–594)
• Automatic wakes blocked if current OR proposed mode == ModeKind::Plan!
• Atomically reserves ActiveTurn::default() under active_turn.lock().await.
• Verifies Arc::ptr_eq(&turn.turn_state, &reserved) before start_task (L565)
so an async interrupt during context setup cannot resurrect a dead turn!
3. ContinueIfIdle { expected_previous_turn_id } (CAS Continuation)
• Compares state.last_started_turn_id == Some(expected); returns
NotSubmittedReason::Superseded if a user turn interleaved!
4. Steer { expected_turn_id } (Target-Pinned Steering)
• Rejects with TurnMismatch if expected_turn_id already completed, preventing
late UI steering keystrokes from corrupting an unrelated subsequent turn.
